theming: Import '@carbon/react/scss/index' (or '@carbon/react' compiled CSS) for the default theme. Themes are g10 (light), g90/g100 (dark) via @carbon/themes.

categories.name: color
categories.guidance: Use Carbon color tokens (e.g. --cds-background, --cds-text-primary, --cds-border-subtle) exposed by the active theme. Never hardcode hex values.

categories.name: spacing
categories.guidance: Use Carbon's spacing scale ($spacing-01 through $spacing-13 in Sass) or the 2x Grid instead of raw pixel values.

categories.name: typography
categories.guidance: Use Carbon type tokens/mixins (e.g. type.heading-03, type.body-01) instead of hardcoded font-size/line-height/letter-spacing.
